{s,u,v,t}, cap-0 u→v, two min cuts

Using the proof's own memberships, take V={s,t,u,v}, S={s,u}, T={v,t}, S′={s,v}, T′={u,t}, and edge e=(u,v) with capacity 1. Then S∩T′={u} and T∩S′={v}, so e goes from the first set to the second and therefore contributes to c(S∩T′, T∩S′), contradicting the quoted local claim.
ground_truth_flaw: The proof claims that the edge u→v is not in the capacity term c(S∩T′, T∩S′).
